note: THE PROVENANCE ADOPTION RATCHET BASELINE. Read by panelAdoption.ratchet.test.js.
NAMES, NEVER A COUNT: every number the rail prints is derived by counting this list.
ADDING a name is mechanical: UPDATE_PROVENANCE_ADOPTION_BASELINE=1 npx vitest run src/components/provenance/panelAdoption.ratchet.test.js
REMOVING a name is a HAND EDIT. The update mode refuses to drop a path, so a
regression cannot be laundered by re-running the generator. Retiring an adopter
costs one reviewable line in a diff, with the reason in the commit message.
Paths are repo-relative with forward slashes, sorted, and the file is LF with a
trailing newline: the rail asserts these bytes are exactly what its writer
produces, so appending one adopter is a one-line diff.
coverage_line_exempt (TERM-047) is the OPPOSITE kind of list: SHRINK-ONLY and hand-edited.
Each key is a derived result surface that renders no CoverageLine; each value is ONE line
starting with its kind (not-a-result-set: / no-counts: / delegates:). The rail fails by name
on an entry that outlives its gap, and no generator ever adds one.

coverage_line_exempt.app/src/components/screener/MethodologyP: not-a-result-set: renders the screener's methodology prose from /api/screener/methodology; nothing is evaluated, so there is nothing to count
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/components/screener/RunNowButton: delegates: hands the finished run to its parent via onResult(toScanResultsPayload(run)); app/src/components/screener/ScanResults.jsx renders that run's four counts
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/components/screener/StructurePro: not-a-result-set: renders the structure-library catalogue from /api/screener/structures (criteria and their sources), not symbols a screen matched
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/charts/widgets/ListSubscri: not-a-result-set: its /api/screener/saved-screens door lists the member's saved screen DEFINITIONS to pick a list source (COV-10); the subscribed members come from /api/charts/list-sources, not an A9 route
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/charts/widgets/PeriodSortR: no-counts: /api/scans/period-change(-groups) return results + count + partial only (scan_period.py); dropped and not-computable are never measured, so two of the four would be invented
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/charts/widgets/ScannerResu: no-counts: the six preset scans return results + count + as_of only (scan_volume.py, scan_gainers.py, scan_ipo.py); no evaluated/dropped/not-computable split exists server-side
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/charts/widgets/VolumeScanW: no-counts: /api/volume-scan/live returns total + shown + universe_top (volume_live.get_live); a surge leaderboard with no evaluated/dropped/not-computable split server-side
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/screener/ScreensManager.js: delegates: its own door lists saved screens and screen alerts; the chosen scan's answer is rendered by app/src/components/screener/ScanResults.jsx, which renders its four counts
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/screener/shell/PresetChips: not-a-result-set: one-click saved-screen presets via useSavedScreens; it applies a spec and lists no results
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/screener/shell/ResultCards: not-a-result-set: reaches /api/screener/saved-screens only through useScreenSpec's savedScreen= door (build D, 2026-09-30), which loads a saved SPEC to apply, never a result set; the screener's results carry their own CoverageLine
coverage_line_exempt.app/src/pages/screener/shell/SaveScanBut: not-a-result-set: saves the current screen spec via useSavedScreens; it lists no results
